panels.title: Consumption
panels.description: Net energy used while driving per distance, weighted by distance (total energy / total distance). Energy is rated range used x rated efficiency, the same method TeslaMate uses.

targets.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
        SELECT n, t0, t1 FROM (VALUES
          (1, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL)
SELECT p.t1 AS time, m.* FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(kwh) * 1000 / NULLIF(convert_km((SUM(km))::numeric, '$length_unit'), 0) AS "consumption__wh_$length_unit" FROM drv WHERE start_date >= p.t0 AND start_date < p.t1) m ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: Real range on a full battery
panels.description: Current battery capacity divided by the consumption of this period: how far a 100% to 0% charge would take you the way you actually drove.

targets.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
        SELECT n, t0, t1 FROM (VALUES
          (1, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100)
SELECT p.t1 AS time, m.* FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT convert_km(((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= p.t1 ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(km), 0) FROM drv WHERE start_date >= p.t0 AND start_date < p.t1), 0))::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "range__$length_unit") m ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: Share of rated range achieved
panels.description: Rated efficiency / your consumption in the selected period. 100% means you drive exactly as the rated range assumes; 80% means the displayed range is about a fifth too optimistic for you. The line inside the dial is the running value through the period.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
d AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', start_date) AS day, SUM(kwh) AS kwh,
             SUM(km) AS km FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT day AS time, (SELECT e FROM eff) * 100
         / NULLIF(SUM(kwh) OVER w / NULLIF(SUM(km) OVER w, 0), 0) AS share
FROM d WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Real range by average speed and temperature
panels.description: Range on a full battery at each average trip speed (steps of 10), one line per outside temperature: Cold below 5 °C (41 °F), Cool 5 to 15 °C (41 to 59 °F), Mild 15 to 25 °C (59 to 77 °F), Warm above 25 °C (77 °F). Average speed includes stops, so motorway cruising sits at the right. Points need at least 5 drives and 50 km (31 mi).

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
b AS (SELECT FLOOR((convert_km((km)::numeric, '$length_unit') / NULLIF(duration_min, 0) * 60) / 10) * 10 AS speed,
             CASE WHEN temp < 5 THEN 'cold' WHEN temp < 15 THEN 'cool'
                  WHEN temp < 25 THEN 'mild' ELSE 'warm' END AS band,
             SUM(kwh) AS kwh, SUM(km) AS km, COUNT(*) AS n
      FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(drv.start_date) AND temp IS NOT NULL AND duration_min > 0
      GROUP BY 1, 2
      HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND SUM(kwh) > 0 AND SUM(km) >= 50)
SELECT speed,
       MAX(convert_km(((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) * km / kwh)::numeric, '$length_unit')) FILTER (WHERE band = 'cold') AS "cold__$length_unit",
       MAX(convert_km(((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) * km / kwh)::numeric, '$length_unit')) FILTER (WHERE band = 'cool') AS "cool__$length_unit",
       MAX(convert_km(((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) * km / kwh)::numeric, '$length_unit')) FILTER (WHERE band = 'mild') AS "mild__$length_unit",
       MAX(convert_km(((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) * km / kwh)::numeric, '$length_unit')) FILTER (WHERE band = 'warm') AS "warm__$length_unit"
FROM b WHERE speed BETWEEN 10 AND 150 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Outside temperature
panels.description: Consumption by outside temperature during the drive. Tiles show consumption relative to your own average in the period (100% = average), so the four charts in this row can be compared directly: the highest numbers are what costs you the most range. Green is at or below average, yellow up to 25% above, red beyond.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
tband AS (
        SELECT b, lo, hi,
               CASE WHEN lo IS NULL THEN '< ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((hi)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
                    WHEN hi IS NULL THEN '> ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((lo)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
                    ELSE ROUND(convert_celsius((lo)::numeric, '$temp_unit')) || ' – ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((hi)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
               END || ' °$temp_unit' AS label
        FROM (VALUES (0, NULL::numeric, 0::numeric), (1, 0, 10), (2, 10, 20),
                     (3, 20, 30), (4, 30, NULL)) v(b, lo, hi))
SELECT tband.label AS temperature, SUM(kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(km), 0) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(km), 0) FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(drv.start_date)), 0) AS index
FROM tband LEFT JOIN drv ON (tband.lo IS NULL OR drv.temp >= tband.lo) AND (tband.hi IS NULL OR drv.temp < tband.hi) AND $__timeFilter(drv.start_date)
GROUP BY tband.b, tband.label HAVING SUM(km) > 0 ORDER BY tband.b

panels.title: Average speed
panels.description: Consumption by average trip speed in $length_unit per hour, stops included. Tiles show consumption relative to your own average in the period (100% = average), so the four charts in this row can be compared directly: the highest numbers are what costs you the most range. Green is at or below average, yellow up to 25% above, red beyond.

WITH eff AS (

                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
l AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0, '< 20'), (1, '20 – 40'), (2, '40 – 60'), (3, '60 – 80'), (4, '> 80')) v(b, label)),
d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN duration_min > 0 THEN LEAST(FLOOR((convert_km((km)::numeric, '$length_unit') / NULLIF(duration_min, 0) * 60) / 20), 4)::int END AS b, kwh, km FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(drv.start_date))
SELECT l.label AS speed, SUM(kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(km), 0) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(km), 0) FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(drv.start_date)), 0) AS index
FROM l LEFT JOIN d USING (b) GROUP BY l.b, l.label
HAVING SUM(km) > 0 ORDER BY l.b

panels.title: Trip length
panels.description: Consumption by trip distance. Short trips pay for warming up the cabin and battery over very few distance units. Tiles show consumption relative to your own average in the period (100% = average), so the four charts in this row can be compared directly: the highest numbers are what costs you the most range. Green is at or below average, yellow up to 25% above, red beyond.

WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (

            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0

          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
l AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0, '< ' || ROUND(convert_km((5)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit'), (1, ROUND(convert_km((5)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' – ' || ROUND(convert_km((20)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit'), (2, ROUND(convert_km((20)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' – ' || ROUND(convert_km((50)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit'), (3, ROUND(convert_km((50)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' – ' || ROUND(convert_km((150)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit'), (4, '> ' || ROUND(convert_km((150)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit')) v(b, label)),
d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN km < 5 THEN 0 WHEN km < 20 THEN 1 WHEN km < 50 THEN 2 WHEN km < 150 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS b, kwh, km FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(drv.start_date))
SELECT l.label AS trip, SUM(kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(km), 0) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(kwh) / NULLIF(SUM(km), 0) FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(drv.start_date)), 0) AS index
FROM l LEFT JOIN d USING (b) GROUP BY l.b, l.label
HAVING SUM(km) > 0 ORDER BY l.b

panels.title: Hills
panels.description: Consumption by net climb of the trip per distance: Downhill (more than 5 m down per km), Flat, Uphill (5 to 15 m up per km), Steep (more than 15 m up per km). Tiles show consumption relative to your own average in the period (100% = average), so the four charts in this row can be compared directly: the highest numbers are what costs you the most range. Green is at or below average, yellow up to 25% above, red beyond.

WITH eff AS (

            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0

drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh

panels.title: Range estimate
panels.description: Type an average speed (in $length_unit per hour) and an outside temperature (in your TeslaMate unit) into the two fields at the top. The estimate is the range on a full battery over all recorded drives within 10 speed units and 5 °C (9 °F) of what you typed, whatever time range is selected. It needs at least 3 such drives.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
i AS (SELECT NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM('$est_speed'), ',', '.'), '')::float8 AS sp,
             CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'F' THEN (NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM('$est_temp'), ',', '.'), '')::float8 - 32) / 1.8
                  ELSE NULLIF(REPLACE(TRIM('$est_temp'), ',', '.'), '')::float8 END AS tc),
m AS (SELECT SUM(kwh) AS kwh, SUM(km) AS km, COUNT(*) AS n
      FROM drv CROSS JOIN i
      WHERE duration_min > 0 AND temp IS NOT NULL
        AND ABS((convert_km((km)::numeric, '$length_unit') / NULLIF(duration_min, 0) * 60) - i.sp) <= 10 AND ABS(temp - i.tc) <= 5)
SELECT CASE WHEN n >= 3 AND kwh > 0
